nina-cs: Quick Day0 smoke for Aspenfold private deploy 1: NAT egress, TGW routes, KMS cross-account, CloudTrail -> S3. Any immediate blockers?
carl-se: TGW attached. Route for telemetry 10.5.12.0/24 missing from rtb-0a. I can add it now.
mei-eng: KMS key alias/aspenfold-audit policy currently allows only account-root. Customer expects ops role arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/aspen-ops to decrypt. I'll draft snippet.
raj-infra: Added route 10.5.12.0/24 -> tgw-22 at 08:14Z; propagation shows "available". Quick curl to collector 18.23.45.67:443 returned 403 (collector IP not whitelisted).
audit-bot: cloudtrail_event: "aspenfold-org-trail" created at 2026-08-12T08:10Z
mei-eng: KMS snippet I'm pushing to runbook: `{"Sid":"AllowOps","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/aspen-ops"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}`
carl-se: Noted. PM said they'll review KMS policy Thu morning. Risk: if approval slips past Thu EOD, flag renewal at-risk. Adding to tracker.
nina-cs: Add mitigation: temporary ingest key we manage (audit-only) requires contract amendment. @carl-se put mitigation in tracker and set owner.
carl-se: Done. Also noticed CloudTrail PutObject initially 403; added explicit allow for `cloudtrail.amazonaws.com` in bucket policy and re-delivery succeeded.
raj-infra: Asked customer to whitelist collector IPs 18.23.45.67 and 34.200.11.9. Awaiting confirmation.
nina-cs: Summary actions: raj - confirm whitelist and post result; mei - paste final KMS snippet in runbook and DM PM; carl - update risk tracker + mitigation owner; nina - schedule Thu follow-up 09:00 UTC. Thanks! :thumbsup:
